skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Ability to measure various types of financial risks including market, credit, operational, and liquidity risks.
Ability to manage and mitigate identified financial risks using quantitative methods.
Proficiency in using Excel for financial analysis and risk assessment.
Proficiency in using R for statistical analysis and modeling in risk management.
Proficiency in using Python for data analysis and algorithmic trading in risk management.
Understanding of regulatory requirements for risk management as per Basel III guidelines.
